goal: Execute the 8 production refactoring backlog tickets (KAN-460 through KAN-467, covering 15,813 lines across 17 oversized Backend, Cookbook SPA, Express SSR, and repo tooling files) in 4 sequential groups (G1..G4) with mandatory human check-in stopping points (C1..C4) after each group so no task in Group N+1 can start until Group N is verified and approved.

hard_gate.rule: Every task's refactored source files meet their post-extraction line-count ceiling and export their backwards-compatible facade symbols, extracted modules exist and are non-empty, all unit/integration suites pass, every group stopping point (C1..C4) has a recorded human check-in approval (.agent-harness/refactor/G<N>.checkin.json), and KAN-460..KAN-467 are Done at close.

repo_scope.rule: All 4 groups branch off and open checkpoint PRs into the dedicated integration branch `chore/refactor_argon_integration` (in both Backend and Cookbook repos) before any final promotion to `dev`. Groups G1 and G2 (KAN-460..KAN-463) modify Backend/; Groups G3 and G4 (KAN-464..KAN-467) modify the cookbook root repo.

G1.name: Group 1 — Backend Core Repository & Public SSR Blueprint
G1.checkin_approve_cmd: python3 scripts/harness/refactor_driver.py checkin G1 --approve --notes "<human review summary>"

G2.name: Group 2 — Backend Worker, Generation & Auth Blueprints
G2.checkin_approve_cmd: python3 scripts/harness/refactor_driver.py checkin G2 --approve --notes "<human review summary>"

G3.name: Group 3 — Cookbook Frontend Services, View Base & Templates
G3.checkin_approve_cmd: python3 scripts/harness/refactor_driver.py checkin G3 --approve --notes "<human review summary>"

G4.name: Group 4 — Express SSR Server, RUM Consent & Repo Tooling Scripts
G4.checkin_approve_cmd: python3 scripts/harness/refactor_driver.py checkin G4 --approve --notes "<human review summary>"

Backend-Core.scope: Group 1 (KAN-460, KAN-461): DbRecipeRepository decomposition and public_bp.py SEO/image/hub service extraction in Backend/.

Backend-API-Auth.scope: Group 2 (KAN-462, KAN-463): worker_api_bp.py, generation_api_bp.py, auth_api_bp.py, and valkey_auth.py service extraction in Backend/.

Frontend-SPA.scope: Group 3 (KAN-464, KAN-465): PersistenceService, AuthService, RecipeViewBase, and generator/kitchen/recipe-detail Angular templates in src/.

SSR-And-Tooling.scope: Group 4 (KAN-466, KAN-467): Express server/index.ts, public/rum/consent.js, and scripts/monitoring/gsc_tools.py, scripts/git/git-workflow.sh, scripts/pm/atlassian_pm_link.py.

Check-In.scope: Group stopping points (C1, C2, C3, C4): run group hard gates, verify all tasks in the group are complete, pause the loop for human review, and record check-in approval before unlocking the next group.
